{"content":"name: Lint Code

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
    
    - name: Install linting tools
      run: |
        pip install pylint flake8 black
    
    - name: Run Black
      run: |
        black --check --config config/linting/black.toml src/
    
    - name: Run Flake8
      run: |
        flake8 --config config/linting/flake8.ini src/
    
    - name: Run Pylint
      run: |
        pylint --rcfile config/linting/pylintrc src/","path":".github/workflows/lint.yml"}

{"content":"version: '3.8'

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: myapp_postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: myapp
      POSTGRES_USER: myapp_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: myapp_password
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U myapp_user"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: myapp_redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  redis_data:","path":"docker-compose.yml"}
